Accessible mapping meetup

The meetup brings together people who build maps that work without sight. This page lists the sessions for the autumn event and explains how to reach the venue by public transport.

Doors open in the morning. Each session runs for forty minutes with time for questions at the end, and a quiet room is available for the whole day.
